card.text: M37 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 1,402 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2099: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 1401.57351157 pc (16th to 84th percentile 1400 to 1403)

sources.quote: Messier 37 is the brightest and richest open cluster in the constellation Auriga.

introduction.text: M37 is drawn as 1,227 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
